    • addEventListener

      public SliderBuilder addEventListener(com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets.interface_.CustomUIEventBindingType type, Consumer<Integer> callback)
      Adds an event listener to the slider builder. The only type it accepts will be ValueChanged.
      Parameters:
      type - the type of the event to listen for, represented by CustomUIEventBindingType. This defines the specific event binding, such as ValueChanged.
      callback - the function to execute when the specified event occurs. The callback receives a Float value.
      Returns:
      the current instance of SliderBuilder, enabling method chaining.

    • addEventListener

      public SliderBuilder addEventListener(com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets.interface_.CustomUIEventBindingType type, BiConsumer<Integer, UIContext> callback)
      Adds an event listener to the slider builder with access to the UI context.
      Parameters:
      type - The type of the event to bind the listener to.
      callback - The function to be executed when the specified event is triggered, with UI context.
      Returns:
      This SliderBuilder instance for method chaining.
